items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I played with Joe Gabriel after he retired in his grocery. They called him Papi for nickname.

ctx.x: And Joe Gabriel was out there too huh?
I played with Joe Gabriel after he retired in his grocery. They called him Papi for nickname.
Papi. I wanted to see him but you know he fainted. Punch and I went up that once.
